description: This script analyzes TypeScript source files to verify that all module specifiers referencing 'openclaw/plugin-sdk/' predictably exist in package exports and entrypoints, aiding in maintaining consistent plugin SDK subpath exports.

methods.name: readPackageExports
methods.description: Reads and returns the set of exported plugin SDK subpaths from package.json.

methods.name: readEntrypoints
methods.description: Reads and returns the set of plugin SDK entrypoints from a JSON file.

methods.name: parsePluginSdkSubpath
methods.description: Extracts and returns the plugin SDK subpath from a module specifier if it matches the expected prefix.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Function to compare two violation entries for sorting purposes.

methods.name: collectViolations
methods.description: Main logic that collects violations where plugin SDK subpaths referenced in source files are missing from package exports or entrypoints.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that runs the violation collection and reports results.
